Frequently Asked Questions

1. Do you provide emergency solar repair near me in Vadodara?
Yes, Atlas Aircon offers 24/7 emergency solar repair vadodara services. We understand that system downtime leads to power loss, so we prioritize urgent breakdown calls in residential and industrial sectors.
2. What is the cost of solar panel cleaning in Vadodara?
Our solar cleaning service vadodara is very affordable, starting from as low as ₹50 per panel or charged on a per kW basis for larger plants. Regular cleaning ensures better generation.
3. Can you fix my inverter showing a red light error?
Absolutely. A red light indicates a fault. Our solar inverter repair vadodara experts will diagnose the specific error code (Ground Fault, Grid Error, etc.) and repair the PCB or settings.
4. Do you repair solar water heaters as well?
Yes, apart from PV systems, we provide solar water heater repair and maintenance services, including tube replacement and tank leakage fixing.
5. Are your technicians certified?
Yes, we deploy only the expert solar panel technician team. They are trained in electrical safety, height work, and handling high-voltage DC systems securely.
6. Do you sell spare parts?
Yes, we have a stock of solar panel spare parts vadodara including MC4 connectors, DC cables, SPD (Surge Protection Devices), and fuses available at our shop.
7. Which areas do you serve outside Vadodara?
We serve nearby regions including solar panel repair Savli, Padra, Karjan, Halol, Anand, and Nadiad for larger installation repairs.
8. Can you repair a cracked solar panel?
Glass cracks cannot be repaired to original efficiency, but we offer solar panel glass replacement or complete panel replacement services to ensure system safety and remove fire risks.
9. Why is my solar bill high despite having panels?
This could be due to dirty panels reducing generation or a solar net meter problem repair requirement. We can investigate your generation data and fix the issue.
10. Do you offer AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts)?
Yes, our solar amc service vadodara ensures your system runs at peak efficiency all year round with scheduled visits for cleaning and technical checkups.
